title: UMCP Kernel Specification
version: UMCP-KERNEL-SPEC.v2.4.0-rc2 (prepared 2026-08-29; implementation baseline GCD/UMCP repository v2.3.3)

tier_1: Restates reserved kernel meaning under [T1] labels without changing any Tier-1 symbol or exact identity. Explicitly not a Tier-1 freeze.
tier_0: Candidate specification of the typed-return interface, mutually exclusive contract-bound seam-accounting profiles, validators, run record (adds seam_accounting_profile as a required field), and implementation boundaries. Adoption requires a separate authority act after the open seams close.

source_role: Current freeze-controlled repair candidate; explicitly not a Tier-1 freeze; preserves open seams (handoff manifest; source status line).
scope: Specify the fixed kernel, typed-return interface, seam-accounting interface, validators, run record, and implementation boundaries as a local technical witness under Summa Reditus, Architecture Freeze v1.0.
non_goal: Is not the corpus, does not replace Summa Reditus, does not absorb RCFT or ULRC, does not independently authorize final stance, and rewrites no historical run.

missingness.notes: Repository v2.3.3 computes unweighted population dispersion; the active UMCP operating witness specifies weighted dispersion.
Inherited R·τ_R versus independently defined Q_R; neither universal; not to be mixed within one run.
Repository v2.3.3 may emit CRITICAL as a primary regime; the mature grammar treats IC < 0.30 as an overlay.
Superseded for review by rc2 per the source; rc1 is not supplied and not registered, so supersedes is null.

notes: Candidate status: this record does not confer active authority. GCD/UMCP repository v2.3.3 is the executable baseline and is not modified by the library.
